title: Jazzy Thai Shrimp Pad See Ew
description: A rich and adventurous Thai dish featuring caramelized shrimp, glassy noodles, and a shattering burst of lime, all cooked over a yakimono grill for a sweet and savory finish.

ingredients.name: shrimp
ingredients.notes: peeled and deveined, thaw if frozen

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and drizzle coconut oil until shimmering.
Add minced garlic and ginger, sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Toss shrimp into the skillet, stir-fry for 2 minutes until pink, then remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, add broccoli, bell pepper, and carrot, stir-fry 3 minutes until crisp-tender.
While vegetables cook, whisk together soy sauce, fish sauce, coconut sugar, and a splash of water until sugar dissolves.
Return shrimp to the skillet, pour the sauce over, and stir until shrimp coat and sauce thickens.
Add soaked noodles, gently toss to combine, and cook another 2 minutes until noodles are heated through.
Squeeze lime wedges over the dish, give a final stir, and taste adjust seasoning with extra soy sauce if needed.
Plate the Pad See Ew onto serving bowls, garnish with fresh cilantro if desired.
Serve immediately, letting diners squeeze additional lime before eating.
